vocabulary.meaning_en: tell someone your name when you meet for the first time
vocabulary.example: Let me introduce myself. I'm Sara.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what people think of you when they first meet you
vocabulary.example: I want to make a good first impression.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first day in a new job
vocabulary.example: It's my first day in the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: become a member of a team or company
vocabulary.example: I've just joined the sales team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of people who work together
an experienced manager who looks after important clients
vocabulary.example: Tom is the Senior Account Manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: higher in rank or with more experience
vocabulary.example: She has a senior role in the company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that pays for a service
vocabulary.example: I have a meeting with an important client.
He has a big deal coming through.
We sealed the deal this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: informal: meet someone and eat lunch together
free to do something or meet someone
vocabulary.example: Are you available at two o'clock?

vocabulary.meaning_en: understand something in the wrong way

vocabulary.example: Sorry, I'm quite busy right now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room where you make food and drinks
vocabulary.example: The office kitchen is through there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: polite friendly conversation about simple topics
vocabulary.example: Small talk helps you make friends at work.
It's easy to make friends in this office.

fine_lines.title: do lunch vs make lunch
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Can you do lunch? تعني: هل أنت متاح لتناول الغداء معي (في مطعم مثلًا)؟ أما make lunch فتعني تحضير الطعام وطبخه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Do lunch" = meet and eat lunch together (informal). "Make lunch" = cook or prepare food.

examples.sentence: Can you do lunch on Friday? There's a nice café nearby.
I make lunch for my children every morning.

fine_lines.title: meet vs met
fine_lines.explanation_ar: meet الحاضر، met الماضي والتصريف الثالث. نقول: Nice to meet you عند أول لقاء، وI don't think we've met (المضارع التام) لأننا نتحدث عن الماضي حتى الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Meet" is the present; "met" is the past and past participle. Say "Nice to meet you" and "I don't think we've met".

examples.sentence: I don't think we've met. I'm Anna.

expressions.phrase: Hello, I don't think we've met.
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا، لا أظن أننا التقينا من قبل.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to start talking to someone new.
expressions.example: Hello, I don't think we've met. I'm Omar.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you think you know who the person is.
expressions.example: You must be the new manager. Welcome!
Hi, I'm Lina. I've just joined the team.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you meet someone for the first time.
expressions.example: Nice to meet you, Mr Brown.

expressions.meaning_ar: هل تعمل هنا منذ مدة طويلة؟
expressions.example: Have you worked here long? You seem to know everyone.
I'm busy now, but let's get together sometime.

grammar.title: Present perfect with "just"
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has + just + التصريف الثالث للحديث عن شيء حدث قبل قليل: I've just joined the team. وكلمة just تأتي بين have والفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: Use have/has + just + past participle for something that happened a very short time ago. "Just" goes between have and the verb.

grammar.title: "must be" for a confident guess
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم must be عندما نكون شبه متأكدين من شيء بناءً على ما نراه: You must be Tom (أنا شبه متأكد أنك توم).
grammar.explanation_en: Use "must be" when you are almost sure about something: You must be Tom.
examples: You must be tired after your trip.
This must be the meeting room.

questions.question: Which is a good first sentence to someone new at work?
choices: Hello, I don't think we've met.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه هي العبارة المهذبة التي تعلّمناها.
questions.explanation_en: This is the polite phrase from the episode.

questions.question: I've just ___ the team.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد have/has just نستخدم التصريف الثالث joined.
questions.explanation_en: After "have just" use the past participle: joined.

questions.question: "Can you do lunch tomorrow?" means...
choices: Are you free to have lunch with me tomorrow?
questions.explanation_ar: do lunch تعني تناول الغداء معًا وليس الطبخ.

questions.question: You see a man at Tom's desk wearing Tom's name badge. You say:
questions.explanation_en: Use "must be" for a confident guess.

questions.question: Choose the friendly small-talk question.
questions.explanation_ar: Have you worked here long? سؤال ودّي مناسب.
questions.explanation_en: It is a polite small-talk question.

questions.question: "Senior" means...
questions.explanation_ar: senior تعني أعلى رتبة أو أكثر خبرة.
questions.explanation_en: Senior means higher in rank or more experienced.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I don't think we met before yesterday ago.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد have نستخدم التصريف الثالث met.

questions.question: Anna thought "do lunch" meant "cook lunch". She ___ Tom.
questions.explanation_ar: فهمت آنا كلام توم بشكل خاطئ، أي أساءت فهمه: misunderstood.

questions.question: What do you say the first time you meet someone?
questions.explanation_ar: Nice to meet you تُقال عند أول لقاء.
questions.explanation_en: Say "Nice to meet you" when you first meet.
